summary: Time-calibrated trees (TimeTree API, Upham mammal trees, Open Tree topology) and Linnaean ranks (COL, Open Tree taxonomy) are open, so sister pairs and their ages and ranks can be listed. A comparable measure of morphological modification per clade exists only for particular groups (AVONET traits for birds; matrices on MorphoBank, which returned 403), so the full test is open only where one such clade is chosen.
next_step: Pick bird and mammal sister clades; join AVONET (birds) or a mammal trait table to the Upham/TimeTree ages and COL ranks, and pre-register the disparity-ratio and rank-asymmetry statistics.
obstacles_confirmed: No single open table pairs clade age, morphological modification and Linnaean rank across all life.
